content: यानम् [या भावे-ल्युट्] .²1 Going, moving, walking, riding; as गजयानम्, उष्ट्र˚, रथ˚ <ab>&c.</ab> .²2 A voyage, journey; समुद्रयानकुशलाः <ls>Ms. 8. 157</ls>; <ls>Y. 1. 84</ls>. .²3 Marching against, attacking (one of the six Guṇas or expedients in politics); अहितान् प्रत्यभीतस्य रणे यानम् <ls>Ak.</ls>; <ls>Ms. 7. 160</ls>. .²4 A procession, train. .²5 A conveyance, vehicle, carriage, chariot; यानं सस्मार कौबेरम् <ls>R. 15. 45</ls>, <ls n="R.">13. 69</ls>; <ls>Ku. 6. 76</ls>; <ls>Ms. 4. 120</ls>. .²6 A litter, palanquin. .²7 A ship, vessel. .²8 (With Buddhists) The method of arriving at knowledge; the means of release from repeated births; <ab>cf.</ab> महायान, हीनयान. .²9 An aeroplane (विमान); <ls>Bhāg. 4. 3. 6</ls>. .{@-नः@} <ab>Ved.</ab> A road, way.
